titre: Cosmétique et hygiène en Europe par catégorie
sous_titre: Milliards d'euros de ventes au détail, 2024

Soin de la peau.texte: Europe's largest category remained skin care in 2024, holding 28.9% of the market with retail sales of €30.1bn.

Hygiène.texte: This was followed by toiletries at 23.8% and €24.7bn in retail sales

Soin des cheveux.texte: hair care at 17.4% and €18.1bn retail sales

Parfums.texte: fragrances and perfumes at 16.5% and €17.1bn retail sales

Maquillage.texte: decorative cosmetics at 13.4% with €13.9bn in retail sales for the year.
